findings.text: follow-on: _local_session_processes re-implements the Claude-record/procStart join that _local_observation already owns in the same module at fleet_migrate.py:124-140 (read .claude/sessions/*.json, take pid+sessionId+cwd, read /proc/<pid>/stat field 19, compare against procStart); it extends the join with cmdline and a claude-command filter but does not reuse the owner, so the procStart field index and the record keys now live in two places that can drift.

follow-on: _active_sessions repeats the zellij list-sessions --no-formatting read already spelled by _local_observation at fleet_migrate.py:98 and by fleet_supervisor.session_running at fleet_supervisor.py:924; its unfiltered, EXITED-aware list differs from both, but the subprocess shape and the EXITED handling are a second copy that can drift from the owner.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 2 production call site(s): reckon/cli.py:790 fleet_node_migrate calls migrate() with the three flags, and reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py:957 dispatches inspect-session/end-session/list-sessions that the cutover and retire steps invoke over the placement argv.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against fdf6d957; ac993f4a7 adds the cutover and retire steps, the local end-session/inspect-session/list-sessions entry points, _active_sessions, _local_session_processes, _client process join, _worker_steps and _cancel_job plus tests/test_fleet_migrate_cutover.py, and 50522014 adds the evidence fragment, 662 insertions and 6 deletions across four files.
item_verdicts.done_when: the section done_when pairs a dry run at every step with a resume-after-interrupt case and a retire that cancels nothing without --confirm; test_cutover_lists_only_remaining_sessions_and_refuses_unknown asserts the cutover dry run changes the ledger nothing, test_cutover_requires_live_claude_and_preserves_retry_checkpoint asserts a second invocation resumes at phase old-ended without re-ending the session, and test_retire_refuses_steps_and_sessions_then_requires_confirmation asserts no cancel without --confirm and one cancel of job 1234 with it.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is the §8 cutover and retire steps; reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py:800 ends the old session, asks the new supervisor to start migrate-<session>.kdl and verifies each pane's tab, conversation id and cwd on the new node, and fleet_migrate.py:919 retires;  the retire branch confirms no worker steps and no zellij sessions then cancels only with --confirm.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the ten-file gate 165 passed EXIT=0 in gate-absolute.log at revision 50522014, the standalone cutover file 11 passed EXIT=0 under failing scheduler binaries in cutover-path-stubs.log, and the retire no-confirm mutation red at EXIT=1 in negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py, recovery.py, cli.py, tests/test_fleet_migrate_cutover.py, tests/test_fleet_migrate.py, the evidence fragment and the figures dir); the diff touches exactly fleet_migrate.py, the two test files and the fragment, all inside them.

justifications.durability: the retire --confirm guard is proven by mutation (negative-control.log reddens test_retire_refuses_steps_and_sessions_then_requires_confirmation at EXIT=1) and test_cutover_requires_live_claude_and_preserves_retry_checkpoint asserts the old-ended checkpoint survives a failed pane check, though the _worker_steps .batch/.extern filter at fleet_migrate.py:481 and the _active_sessions parser are injected in every test and have no direct assertion.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records the gate result rather than claiming it: gate-absolute.log revision=50522014beeb295e8a88e9b494f57c7c7cede25c ends 165 passed in 119.41s with EXIT=0, and cutover-path-stubs.log runs the cutover file with sbatch/srun/scancel stubbed to exit 91, 11 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: the diff follows the module's injected-callable idiom (fleet_migrate.py:579 inspect_session/list_worker_steps/cancel_job default to the real reader), the ledger-write pattern and its type hints; no symbol or comment carries a plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: fleet_migrate.py:800-880 ends the old session through end-session, sends session <name> migrate-<name> to the new supervisor and compares each pane's (tab, conversation, cwd) against the census before recording cutovers[<session>].status complete, and fleet_migrate.py:919-948 checks worker steps and old-node zellij sessions before a --confirm-gated scancel, so both §8 steps are present.
justifications.reuse: the cutover and retire steps reuse the ledger, placement_argv, _send_supervisor and _run_step owners, but fleet_migrate.py:397 re-implements the Claude-record/procStart join owned at fleet_migrate.py:124 and fleet_migrate.py:364 repeats the zellij list-sessions read owned at fleet_migrate.py:98 and fleet_supervisor.py:924.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff fdf6d957..50522014 touches exactly reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py, tests/test_fleet_migrate_cutover.py, tests/test_fleet_migrate.py and the evidence fragment, 662 insertions and 6 deletions, all inside the declared write paths.
